Hi Anna / team —

Thanks for the quick responses. I updated the MAP (attached) with explicit procurement checkpoints and billing flow options. Summary of the two paths we can support:

Option A — AWS Marketplace-managed funds (preferred for faster onboarding):
- Redwood configures the AWS Private Offer: PO-789234
- Kestrel accepts in their AWS Marketplace account
- AWS handles invoicing and settlement to Redwood (standard AWS billing cadence)
- Pros: faster, reduces AR for Kestrel; Cons: limited custom invoice fields

Option B — Redwood direct invoicing (if Kestrel requires custom remit-to or P-card):
- Redwood sends DocuSign PO/contract to Kestrel
- Redwood issues invoice to mike.harris@kestrel.com after counter-signature
- Net terms: Net 30 (default) or Net 45 with approval

Per Anna's ask: we can deliver a plain-language SOC 2 summary today and a full report via our security portal (link below) once NDA/Evidence request formalized.

Action items:
- Anna: please confirm preferred billing path (A or B) and final sign date (we can target 2028-05-12).
- Mike: if Option B, please share AP PO number format and remit-to info.
- Aditya: confirm acceptance environment URL and share test account credentials.

Related links: HubSpot deal KD-2981 (internal note added), AWS private offer PO-789234 created (placeholder).

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Marketplace Sales

Hi all —

Tech acceptance details below and a lightweight test plan you can run during the two-week eval. I'm including the acceptance checklist as a PDF in the attachments.

Acceptance environment: us-west-2 sandbox (provision token included in HubSpot deal notes)
Test plan highlights:
- Latency smoke: 1k samples from Kestrel workload (95th < 250ms for 512 tokens)
- Functional: prompt templates A/B — verify deterministic output for inference pipeline
- Data residency: sandbox hosted within us-west-2 with KV cache disabled for eval
- Security: SOC 2 summary and evidence request link: https://security.redwood.com/evidence/request/KD-2981

If tests pass, we mark 'Tech acceptance' complete and Redwood will flip the acceptance flag in the MAP sheet. If Kestrel needs a longer acceptance window we can extend by 3 business days.

I'll be available for a run-through on Wed 2028-05-02 at 10:00 PT if you want to walk the test plan together.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer
